Theme

Playground equipment, sandbox toys, vehicles and play

playpen noun

also play pen, play-pen

* our formation

* (our own formation) saeptum lūsōrium

Our description, on the house pattern for toys (see toy version): saeptum, a fence or enclosure, also a fold for animals (Lewis & Short). No ancient name is known, and Traupman, Morgan–Owens and Levi–Bini give none.

Examples

  • Manē in saeptō lūsōriō, dum cēnam coquō.

    Stay in your playpen while I cook supper.composed

See also fence, cot, baby, toy version.

SourcesLewis & Short: saeptum · Lewis & Short: lusorius

Traupman, Morgan–Owens and Levi–Bini have no word for a playpen (searched under playpen, play pen, and Italian box, recinto).

The example sentence marked “composed” is ours.
